text:
Sloane: kicking off activation for ACME-East private cluster (eu-west-1a). aiming to flip traffic 03/26. need quick checklist: customer firewall allowlist, egress proxy creds, seed registry sync, GPU driver image preloaded, and cost caps. who can join 2pm PST?
Matt: I can. do we have the customer's fw IP ranges? also want to confirm whether they prefer NFS or S3 for model artifacts (affects installer knobs).
Aisha: they pasted ranges in the ticket — 35.198.12.0/22 and 34.120.50.0/23. putting the minimal rules we ask for below.
Aisha: ```
# minimal customer-facing firewall rules
# control plane ingress (from customer site)
ALLOW TCP 443 FROM 35.198.12.0/22
ALLOW TCP 10250 FROM 35.198.12.0/22  # kubelet (if they want node-level ops)
# seed registry egress (to customer's on-prem registry VIP)
ALLOW TCP 443 TO 10.0.0.0/16
# optional: allow SSH for support jumpbox
ALLOW TCP 22 FROM 34.120.50.0/23
```
Infra-bot: seed_artifact_sync started at 2190011300; progress 0/12 images pulled. will post updates.
Ryan: note for air-gapped installs: we scp the tarball, verify checksums, run `./install.sh --verify`, then register nodes. also ensure we preload the driver container for 535.86.01 - some of our kernels need that.
Matt: add to checklist: customer requires HSM-backed keywrap — confirm KMS endpoint reachable over TLS1.2 and that we don't leak egress to other regions. they explicitly disallow outbound to non-eu ranges.
Sloane: cost guard: set node auto-scale max to 8 GPUs, enable preemptible fallback and set budget alert to $1,200/day (we can tweak after day-1 telemetry).
Leo: quick smoke validation to run after nodes join: `kubectl get nodes && nvidia-smi -L && curl -f https://internal-health/ready` — also run a small perf job to exercise KV cache.
Sam: I'll take the post-activation handoff after 2pm — will run smoke tests, verify model pull from seed registry, and post logs to the ticket + #incidents if anything fails. :thumbsup:
Aisha: updated the support ticket with firewall snippet, installer checksum, and the required driver tag. pinging @acme-ops for confirmation (they should reply with a timestamp).
Sloane: thanks all — meeting 2pm PST. agenda: confirm fw opens, see seed sync progress, confirm driver image staged, final go/no-go. ping here if anything blocks before the meeting.
